affected_predicate.description: an SMS reminder is sent to the recipient containing exactly the awaiting-shipment product name and order number

competing_trace_defects.description: At step 7, the claimed SMS-reminder click produced no visible UI change; the order-details screen remained displayed.

chains.rationale: The reused claim states that SMS initiation occurred, but the source action left the order-details UI unchanged. At the reuse target, the agent relied on that claim and submitted the product name and order number as an answer; the screen remained unchanged and no SMS composition or sending action is visible. No corrective action follows.

summary: The reused false SMS-initiation claim was followed by terminal answer submission rather than an observable SMS send; the required reminder predicate remains visibly unsatisfied.
